toegepas.voor: wat vir jou sorg mag ook
toegepas.na: wat vir jou sorg, mag ook
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS: a comma after an embedded relative clause where two verbs meet (sorg, mag).
toegepas.fout: Two verbs from different clauses meet ('sorg mag') with no comma, so a Grade 4 reader can stumble.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The AWS comma between the embedded clause and the main verb aids reading and changes no word.

toegepas.voor: vir jou hulle privaat dele wys
toegepas.na: vir jou sy privaat dele wys
toegepas.rede_vinder: Coming right after sentences where 'Hulle' means the caregivers, 'hulle' can be misread; 'sy' agrees with 'Niemand', as 'hom' does for 'iemand' elsewhere in the lesson.
toegepas.fout: 'hulle' follows sentences where 'Hulle' means the caregivers, so it can be read as their private parts.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'sy' agrees with 'Niemand', as 'hom' does for 'iemand' elsewhere, and removes the misreading without changing the rule.

toegepas.blok: As niemand naby jou help nie
toegepas.voor: Die oproep is gratis en dit werk vanaf alle netwerke.
toegepas.na: Die oproep is gratis, en dit werk op alle netwerke.
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma between two clauses with their own subject and verb; 'op alle netwerke' is the idiomatic preposition.
toegepas.fout: The AWS comma between two clauses with their own subject and verb is missing, and 'vanaf alle netwerke' is stiff.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The required comma and the idiomatic 'op alle netwerke' say the same fact: the free call works whichever network the child uses.

toegepas.na: Jy het net een liggaam, en goeie sorg hou dit sterk.

laat_vaar.voor: Niemand mag op 'n manier aan jou raak wat jou ongemaklik laat voel nie
laat_vaar.na: Niemand mag aan jou raak op 'n manier wat jou ongemaklik laat voel nie
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Puts the relative clause directly after 'n manier', so 'wat' clearly refers to the manner of touching.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Placing the relative clause after the verb is normal Afrikaans and already reads clearly; the proposal is a lateral reorder of a safety rule.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'soos as' is colloquial; 'soos wanneer' is the standard form and matches the glossary's own usage.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'soos as' is accepted, natural Afrikaans and matches the lesson's other 'as' clauses; swapping it is lateral in a sentence that sets a safety condition.

laat_vaar.blok: Ook vir iemand wat jy ken
laat_vaar.voor: wat jy ken en liefhet en vertrou
laat_vaar.na: wat jy ken, liefhet en vertrou
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: A three-item list reads more naturally with a comma and one 'en'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The repeated 'en' is a deliberate emphatic rhythm and reads naturally; the comma list is only different.

laat_vaar.blok: As niemand naby jou help nie
laat_vaar.voor: Jy bel 116 enige tyd van die dag of die nag.
laat_vaar.na: Jy kan 116 enige tyd van die dag of die nag bel.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Jy bel 116' reads as a bare statement; 'Jy kan ... bel' says naturally that the child may call at any time.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Jy bel 116' is natural Afrikaans for how to reach the line, and adding 'kan' shifts the Childline instruction from a plain statement to a possibility.

laat_vaar.voor: 'n Valhelm hou jou kop veiliger op 'n fiets.
laat_vaar.na: Op 'n fiets hou 'n valhelm jou kop veiliger.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: At the end, 'op 'n fiets' attaches to 'jou kop'; moved to the front it clearly means when you ride.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'hou jou kop veiliger op 'n fiets' is idiomatic and clear; fronting the phrase is a lateral reorder.

laat_vaar.na: Vra daarom voordat jy aan hom raak.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'aanraak' needs an object; 'aan hom raak' links back to 'Iemand anders' in the sentence before.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Intransitive 'aanraak' is accepted Afrikaans (as in 'Moenie aanraak nie'), and adding 'aan hom' narrows and rewords an instruction for a marginal gain.

na_skrywer.voor: Hulle moet eers sê hoekom en jou vra.
na_skrywer.na: Hulle moet eers sê hoekom en jou vra of hulle mag.
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'jou vra' has no object and reads unfinished; this completes it the way the clinic block does, without new content.
na_skrywer.fout: 'jou vra' has no object and reads unfinished.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: Completing it states what is asked, which changes a safety instruction about consent; the writer owns that wording.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

na_skrywer.blok: Ook vir iemand wat jy ken
na_skrywer.voor: Dan is dit moeiliker om te praat en jy praat steeds.
na_skrywer.na: Dan is dit moeiliker om te praat, maar praat steeds.
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: The second clause contrasts with the first, so 'maar' (with the AWS comma) is needed; 'en jy praat steeds' reads as an odd statement rather than the intended instruction.
na_skrywer.fout: 'en jy praat steeds' joins a contrast with 'en' and is ambiguous between a statement and an instruction.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The fix turns the sentence into an imperative, which changes a safety instruction; the writer must choose the wording.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.teks: Medisyne is 'n middel wat help om siekte of pyn te behandel.
vlae.rede: This sentence gives only the first half of the decided shared definition of medisyne, which also covers prevention ('of om te keer dat 'n mens siek word'); the lesson's glossary has the full wording, so the two differ. Completing it adds content, so it is not changed here.
